# The b. Life - theblife.com
# See /llms.txt for full content description

> The b. Life is a digital platform for intentional living, offering free courses on AI literacy (AI for Humans, 109 articles) and mindful living (Living with AI, 71 articles), community discussions, personalized news, local events, and a book by David Crowell.

- https://theblife.com/community/ai-for-humans — AI for Humans course (free, 12 modules)
- https://theblife.com/community/living-with-ai — Living with AI course (free, 8 modules)
- https://theblife.com/book — The b. Life book
- https://theblife.com/subscribe — Newsletter signup
